stations.title: Theo
stations.say: Why does the shelf say Wickhollow?

stations.title: Theo's labels
stations.text: They write each label over the shelf list.

captions: Theo made labels for the newsletter, and now the shelf list looks wrong.
His code wrote the labels over the shelf, because both names share one list.
You write functions that hand back new lists and leave the shelf alone.
Now the newsletter gets its labels and the shelf comes out as it was.
The shop has one shelf list, and nothing breaks it by accident any more.
